notes.title: Update to version 32.4 Release notes
notes.notes:
Windows users can update to version 32.4

The updates are as follows:

-Fixed a rare issue where the game would crash when saving.

notes.title: Update to version 32.3.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Windows users can update to version 32.3.1



The updates are as follows:



・All fonts available without login

・Added Webtoon preset

・Delete Stream Preset

・Twitter has been changed to X

・Fixed to display the angle adjustment bar of the navigator

・Fixed line blur when using concentric circle ruler

・Fixed an issue where the project window would not open after minimizing the screen.

notes.title: Update to version 31.1 Release notes
notes.notes:
Windows users can now update to version 31.1

The menu has been reorganized for improved usability!

The updates are as follows:

- Settings-related items have been moved to "File"
- Brush size change items have been moved to "Edit"
- Panel display items have been moved to "Window"
- "Cloud" has been removed from the menu
